content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for AIIMS Gorakhpur Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Other conditions: Female candidates are preferred for the Project Technical Support-I post. Desirable: Experience in working in research projects at least for 1 year. At least one publication in Medline/PubMed indexed journals in the relevant area (SCI listed). PhD in Public Health/Social Work/Nutrition/Nursing. Well-versed in recording data and effective communication skills. Experience in counseling on breastfeeding and Kangaroo Mother Care.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for AIIMS Gorakhpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates already working against regular/permanent posts under government Department/organizations are not eligible to apply.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Masters in Public Health (MPH)/ Social Work (MSW)/ M.Sc. in Nutrition/ M.Sc. in Nursing from a recognized University/ Institution. Experience required: Experience in working in research projects at least for 1 year is desirable. Age limit: Maximum 35 years. Pay: 56,000 + 20% HRA (Rs. 67,200 ). Qualification required: Three Years Graduate degree in relevant subject /field + one year experience in relevant subject. Experience required: One year experience in relevant subject. Age limit: Maximum 28 years. Pay: 18000 + 20% HRA (Rs. 21600 ).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Project human resource positions initially for a period of 12 months or less. Extension depends on performance evaluation, project tenure, fund availability, and functional requirements.

content_sections.heading: How Will AIIMS Gorakhpur Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Interview / personal discussion Interview time is 11:00 AM to 12:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Filled application format Photo Identity proof Address proof Proof of date of birth (10th Certificate/ Birth certificate) Recent passport size photographs (two) Category certificate Relevant Marksheets and Certificates (10th, 12th, Qualifying degree) Experience certificate

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Gorakhpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Bring duly filled application form in the prescribed format. Attach a recent passport size colour photograph and detailed bio-data/CV. Bring self-attested copies of educational qualifications, working experience, age, caste, and photo ID. Attend on 5 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview. Employed candidates must submit a No Objection Certificate from their employer. Selected candidate will have to join within 15 days of result declaration.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for AIIMS Gorakhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Gorakhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Research Scientist -1 (Non-Medical), 1 Technical Support I.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AIIMS Gorakhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 5 November 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Research Scientist -1 (Non-Medical): maximum 35 years; Technical Support I: maximum 28 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 56,000 + 20% HRA (Rs. 67,200 ) for Research Scientist -1 (Non-Medical), 18000 + 20% HRA (Rs. 21600 ) for Technical Support I.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's degree in Public Health, Social Work, Nutrition, or Nursing, or a Three Years Graduate degree. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Female candidates are preferred for the Project Technical Support-I post.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates already working against regular/permanent posts under government Department/organizations are not eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview / personal discussion. Interview time is 11:00 AM to 12:00 PM.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Project human resource positions initially for a period of 12 months or less. Extension depends on performance evaluation, project tenure, fund availability, and functional requirements.
